name: SHIREFIT TRAIL ROX LEEDS
short_description: SHIREFIT TRAIL ROX PAIRS COMPETITION Trail Rox is back! Hyrox with a twist... Tackle steep hills on our 750m run loop, coupled with keg ground to overhead, log lunges, ski erg, row and more. Hosted at our West Yorkshire site in Calverley, this is perfect to add to your Hyrox training calendar, or to simply test your fitness Summer 2026. Same Sex Pairs and Mixed Pairs tickets available. £60 per team. Keep an eye out in your emails for a 10% discount code if you competed in Trail Rox 2025.
address: SHIREFIT Crowther House, Ravenscliffe Road, Calverley LEEDS LS28 5RZ
